text:
olivia: kicking off gated DDL canary for tenant_profiles.schema_swap in the 22:00 UTC change window. target shard: shard-17. plan: apply swap ddl + tiny backfill (<=500 rows), monitor locks for 10m, then expand if green. requesting approvals and rollback plan ack.
deploy-bot: Canary job created: job_id=canary-202306+17, scheduled at 2023-07-10T22:00:00Z. will post progress updates here.
jordan: ack from infra side. do we have a pinned runtime for the migrator image? want to avoid drift during the window.
meera: migrator pinned to redwood/migrator:v2.4.1 in the canary config. logs will be pushed to #eng-runtime.
sam: small note — please set a per-statement timeout for the backfill to avoid long-held locks. i recommend 30s for the snippet and keep retry logic.
meera: good call. adding `SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '30s';` around the backfill. also wrapping in `pg_try_advisory_lock` for the high-contention table.
jordan: can you paste the exact SQL block you'll run? want to add to release notes snippet.
meera: here —
```sql
BEGIN;
PERFORM pg_advisory_lock(12345);
SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '30s';
UPDATE tenant_profiles SET new_id = uuid_generate_v4() WHERE new_id IS NULL LIMIT 500;
COMMIT;
```
meera: the LIMIT is handled by the migrator loop; above is illustrative. will run single iteration for canary.
olivia: rollback plan: if locks > 5s median or any p99 latency spike > 150ms for read path, abort and revert to previous view (we keep ghost table). will run `deploybot rollback canary-202306+17` and then mark release-notes with canary-fail.
sre-bot: alert rule added: `canary-ddl-locks-shard-17` — alert if >3 lock waiters for >10s or lock wait latency p95 > 2s. Incident channel set to #incidents.
devex: heads-up for docs team — include snippet and instructions to pin migrator image and note the `statement_timeout` mitigation in release notes.
jordan: one more: how are we handling schema version pinning for API servers? we need to ensure consumers won't write fields that assume new schema until rollout completes.
olivia: API servers will read old and new via feature flag `profiles_schema_v2`. rollout is gated: only enable flag after full expansion. adding check to canary job to validate read+write behavior for a sample tenant.
sam: running a quick dry-run in staging now, will post results in 5m.
sam: staging dry-run: no lock spikes, 0 failed statements, sample tenant write/read validated. logs: `canary-staging-1689004321.log` (uploaded).
olivia: thanks. proceeding with final go/no-go at 21:45 UTC. if any +1s before that, we proceed. if no responses by 21:45, we hold and re-evaluate tomorrow. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
jordan: +1 from infra.
meera: +1 and will watch migrator logs.
sam: +1 from QA (ran smoke checks).
olivia: go-ahead. deploy-bot: trigger canary now.
deploy-bot: Trigger accepted. canary in-progress — step 1/4 apply-ddl, step 2/4 small-backfill, step 3/4 verification, step 4/4 expand. will post step updates and final status. :rocket:
